dct_creator_sm: Santana Quintero, Mario (Carleton University). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3836-9714
dct_description_sm: This is a dataset of information compiled for the CIVE3207 (ARCN4100) Historic Site Recording and Assessment course in 2020. Undergraduate students of the Architectural Conservation and Sustainability Program (Engineers and architects) at Carleton University will use these data to produce a Heritage Recording of this important Site. This dataset contains records of the exterior and interior of this historic house. Additional data has been collected on March 12, 2021).
